job.title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
job.description: Designs, deploys, and maintains scalable cloud infrastructure across AWS, Azure, or GCP. Ensures high availability, security, and cost optimization of cloud resources.
job.note: Certification in AWS/Azure cloud architecture is a plus.

job.title: Mobile App Developer
job.description: Develops and maintains native or cross-platform mobile applications for iOS and Android. Works closely with UX teams to deliver smooth, performant user experiences.
job.note: Experience with React Native or Flutter preferred.

job.title: Security Analyst
job.description: Monitors systems for security breaches, conducts vulnerability assessments, and implements measures to protect organizational data and infrastructure.
job.note: Knowledge of penetration testing tools and OWASP standards required.

job.title: Data Analyst
job.description: Collects, processes, and analyzes large datasets to identify trends and provide actionable business insights through reports and dashboards.
job.note: Proficiency in SQL, Excel, and visualization tools like Power BI or Tableau.

job.title: Scrum Master
job.description: Facilitates Agile ceremonies, removes team blockers, and ensures the development team follows Scrum practices to deliver projects on time.

job.title: Content Writer
job.description: Creates clear, engaging, and SEO-optimized content for blogs, websites, and marketing materials. Collaborates with marketing and design teams.
job.note: Strong portfolio of published writing samples required.

job.title: Network Administrator
job.description: Maintains and troubleshoots organizational network infrastructure including routers, switches, firewalls, and VPNs to ensure reliable connectivity.
job.note: CCNA certification or equivalent experience preferred.

job.title: Performance Test Engineer
job.description: Designs and executes load, stress, and performance test scripts to evaluate application scalability and identify bottlenecks under high traffic.
job.note: Experience with JMeter, k6, or LoadRunner required.

job.title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
job.description: Manages end-to-end recruitment process including sourcing, screening, interviewing, and onboarding candidates for technical and non-technical roles.
job.note: Familiarity with LinkedIn Recruiter and ATS tools preferred.

job.title: Product Owner
job.description: Defines product vision, prioritizes the backlog, and works with stakeholders and development teams to ensure delivery of high-value features.
job.note: Strong stakeholder management and prioritization skills needed.
